title: Phân tích kinh doanh bảo hiểm

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply methods for analyzing business operations in insurance companies, including financial activities, investment activities, and other operations.
Analyze core insurance business, reinsurance business, financial activities, investment activities, and other operations.
Evaluate business results and effectiveness, and develop policies and strategies for insurance companies.
Develop independent research and analytical skills, logical and critical thinking, teamwork, presentation, and leadership skills.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, and improve the efficiency of operations in insurance companies.

prerequisite_courses: Quản trị kinh doanh bảo hiểm 2
